reason: The cited handler sets the response to include a page snapshot and performs a browser click/double-click on a page locator using agent-supplied parameters. That supports UNTRUSTED because the returned snapshot is web-page content, which may be attacker-controlled. It also supports SINK because the tool sends agent-controlled interaction data such as the target, button, modifiers, and click count into the web page, which can be observed by a controlled page. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not by themselves establish that the included snapshot is non-public or credentialed data, so SECRET is insufficient.
